messages:
Jordan (AM): Acme Health confirmed POC interest but with two hard constraints: EU and Mexico-only data paths. Asks: 1) Can we guarantee data never leaves those jurisdictions for their tenant? 2) BYOK in EU + MX? 3) Subprocessor list covering MX and EU. 4) Pricing delta for geo-pin and egress isolation.

Mira (SE): TL;DR: Hosted API = fast but cannot guarantee Mexico-only. EU pinning doable for Dedicated. BYOK supported on Dedicated/Private; hosted BYOK constrained. Need to validate MX subproc footprint.

Alex S (Security): For EU hosted we use AWS (eu-west-1, eu-central-1), GCP europe-west*, global CDN. Mexico: we rely on provider POPs in nearby regions (Mexico traffic typically egresses via US or GCP latam), no managed MX datacenter. If customer needs sovereign MX residency, we must provision Private/on-prem or a partner VPC in MX (we've done one-off). I'll draft subproc inventory and callouts.

Priya (Solutions): Options summary for customer: Hosted API: can't promise MX-only. Dedicated: can pin to EU; MX still not guaranteed unless we run dedicated infra in MX. Private/on-prem: meets strict residency but requires SOW and lead time. For POC propose a hybrid test to demonstrate routing and latency.

Jordan (AM): They need a one-page subproc + routing note for Legal and price bands for geo-pin (monthly), BYOK setup, and Private provisioning estimate. Can someone produce?

Alex S (Security): I'll produce the one-pager with subproc list, routing guarantees language, audit/logging controls, and BYOK caveats. Note language will be careful: "geographic affinity" for hosted; strict country-only residency only for Private.

Mira (SE): Pricing scratch: geo-pin addon ~ +15-25% on committed monthly (depends on standby capacity), BYOK one-time ~ $8k-$15k, Private setup estimate starting ~$120k plus infra OPEX. I'll convert to ranges for the quote.

presales-bot: Ticket PS-2025-119 created: Acme Health geo-residency POC. Assignees: Mira (SE), Alex S (Security).

Jordan (AM): Action items: Alex 1 one-pager by EOD tomorrow; Mira 1 include geo-pin pricing and fallback behavior in the POC quote; Priya 1 schedule network/CIDR + latency SLO call with customer.

Priya (Solutions): Scheduling Thursday 30m. I'll ask for expected RPS, sample prompts, embeddings persistence needs, and whether they require customer-managed KMS in EU/MX.

Alex S (Security): Draft routing clause for Legal: "Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to route and process Customer Data within selected regions. Where strict country-only processing cannot be guaranteed due to third-party infrastructure constraints, Provider will document fallback paths and deliver audit logs."

Jordan (AM): Perfect. Drop the one-pager and the POC quote link when ready. :thumbsup:
